title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E36 — Hot Rod Herman
Herman drag-races in the family hearse to back up Eddie's boast that his dad is a better driver than his friend's father.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E37 — Herman's Raise
When Herman is forced to work overtime at the parlor, Lily grows furious and convinces him that he deserves a raise; he is fired when he demands an increase in pay.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E38 — Yes, Galen, There Is a Herman
Herman rescues a little boy whose head is trapped in the park railings, but doesn't get all the credit he deserves; Herman strikes up a friendship with the youngster.

title: The Munsters
description:
S2 E13 — Underground Munster
Herman causes a major crisis when he chastises Spot for tracking mud into the house.

title: The Munsters
description:
S2 E1 — Herman's Child Psychology
Eddie runs away when one of his friends convinces him that all parents are mean.

title: The Munsters
description:
S2 E2 — Herman, the Master Spy
Herman decides to try out his diving equipment while at the ocean.

title: The Munsters
description:
S2 E3 — Bronco-Bustin' Munster
Herman competes in a bronco-busting contest.

title: The Munsters
description:
S2 E4 — Herman Munster, Shutterbug
Herman is in a jam when he inadvertently takes pictures of a bank robbery.

title: The Munsters
description:
S2 E5 — Herman, Coach of the Year
Herman appoints himself Eddie's track coach.

title: The Frozen Ghost
description:
S1
When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum.

title: The Funhouse
description:
S1
Naughty teens (Elizabeth Berridge, Cooper Huckabee, Miles Chapin) are locked in a carnival fun house with a man in a Frankenstein mask.

title: The Ghost of Frankenstein
description:
S1
Shepherd Igor rescues the monster from a sulfur pit and brings him to Dr. Frankenstein's other son.

title: Halloween II
description:
S1
A killer follows his injured target (Jamie Lee Curtis) to the hospital on Oct. 31 in Haddonfield, Ill.

title: House of Dracula
description:
S1
A scientist (Onslow Stevens) helps the Wolf Man (Lon Chaney) and Dracula (John Carradine), and revives Frankenstein's monster.

title: House of Frankenstein
description:
S1
A mad doctor (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked helper (J. Carrol Naish) revive Dracula, the Wolf Man (Lon Chaney) and the Frankenstein monster.

title: House of Horrors
description:
S1
An insane sculptor sends the disfigured criminal he saved from drowning to kill the critics who denounced him.

title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
description:
S1
Exposure to a mysterious fog causes a man (Grant Williams) to shrink, making the world around him extremely hazardous.

title: The Invisible Man Returns
description:
S1
A man (Vincent Price) framed for murder uses a serum to become invisible, then escapes to find the killer.
